workspaces.gone: This workspace is no longer hosted by this environment.

pairing.title: Environment pairing
pairing.lead: Environments asking to connect, and those already paired.
pairing.error: The list could not be read.

requests.title: Pending requests
requests.help: Hand the code to whoever actually administers that environment: that gesture, and only it, is the acceptance. Pairing completes when they paste it on their side.

code.gone: This request no longer exists: it expired or was just rejected.
code.handOver: Read out or paste this code to the environment's administrator.
code.label: Pairing code
code.perishable: The code changes with every window and is single-use. It cannot be printed or downloaded.

reject.title: Reject this request?
reject.body: The request from {{url}} will disappear and its code will stop working. The environment will have to ask again.

paired.contactHelp: The address this module dials to notify the stack — of a revocation, for instance. It is part of no signature: only the origin the stack declares is verified. Change it if an intermediary stands in the way.
paired.contactError: Address refused. An http(s) origin without a path is expected.
paired.devicesUnknownHelp: The device registry does not exist yet: this number is unknown, and is deliberately not shown as zero.

revoke.title: Revoke this pairing?
revoke.body: The pairing of {{url}} to environment “{{label}}” ({{slug}}) will be broken.
revoke.bodyUnattached: The pairing of {{url}} will be broken. It is not attached to any environment.
revoke.devices: {{count}} device(s) will be put back to awaiting assignment and will no longer start until a human reassigns them.
revoke.devicesUnknown: The device registry does not exist yet: the number of devices that will be put back to awaiting assignment is unknown, and is therefore not shown as zero.
revoke.keys: This stack's key will be destroyed. To pair again it will have to knock anew, and a human will have to accept a fresh request.
revoke.environmentKept: The environment stays in the registry: revoking applies to the pairing, not to it.
revoke.error: Revocation failed. The reloaded list will show this pairing's real state.
revoke.bodyParametrage: The pairing of configuration module {{url}} will be broken.
revoke.parametrageConfided: Whatever was entrusted to it ceases to be, and it will have to ask again after a fresh pairing.

designation.caption: Environment
designation.label: Environment from the registry
designation.help: Environments that are already paired are not offered: an environment carries at most one pairing.
designation.required: The code cannot be shown until an environment is chosen: showing it accepts the pairing, and we must know what to link it to.
designation.createHelp: The new environment will immediately be chosen for this request.
designation.attachHelp: This pairing was concluded before environments were declared. Linking it touches neither the keys nor the pairing.

errors.taken: Another pairing already carries this environment. Pick a different one, or revoke the existing pairing.
errors.settled: This pairing is settled: its environment is no longer changed from a request. Change it on the pairing itself, in the list of paired environments.
errors.environmentGone: This environment is no longer in the registry. Refresh the list.
errors.requestGone: This request is gone: it expired, or it was just rejected.
errors.unexpected: Choosing the environment failed. Try again, then check the logs.
errors.devices: This pairing carries devices: its environment is not changed with one click. Move the devices to the target environment first.
errors.changedElsewhere: This pairing's environment has just been changed elsewhere. Refresh the list before trying again.
errors.speciesHasNoEnvironment: This requester is not an environment: it receives no devices, and there is nothing to assign it.

move.help: The environment can only be changed while this pairing carries no device. As soon as it carries one, the devices must be moved first.
move.title: Change this pairing's environment?
move.body: The pairing of {{url}} will leave the “{{fromLabel}}” ({{fromSlug}}) environment for “{{toLabel}}” ({{toSlug}}).
move.keys: The keys do not move: the stack stays paired and has nothing to redo.
move.devices: No device is moved: this change is only allowed while this pairing carries none.

species.caption: Kind
species.parametrageConsequence: Will be entrusted with the git connections. Only one is ever paired.

workspaces.caption: Exposed workspaces
workspaces.empty: This configuration module has not entrusted us with any workspace yet.
workspaces.error: The exposed workspaces could not be read.

workspacePlacement.caption: Hosted workspace
workspacePlacement.noneExposed: No workspace exposed: have them entrusted from the configuration module.
workspacePlacement.notExposed: No paired configuration module exposes this workspace. Exposed: {{exposed}}.
workspacePlacement.error: The workspace could not be placed.

environments.title: Environments
environments.lead: The environments this module knows, and which stack is paired to each.
environments.error: The list could not be read.

form.label: Label
form.labelHelp: What people read. It can be renamed at any time.
form.slugHelp: What gets written: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. Proposed from the label, yours to change — once changed, the label no longer rewrites it.

delete.title: Delete this environment?
delete.body: {{label}} will disappear from the list. Devices can no longer be sent to it.

errors.label: The label is empty, too long, or carries control characters.
errors.slug: A slug is made of lowercase letters, digits and hyphens — and it cannot be empty.
errors.slugTaken: Another environment already carries this slug.
errors.paired: This environment carries a pairing. Revoke it first.
errors.unexpected: The server refused, without saying why.
errors.designated: A pending pairing request points at this environment. Reject it, or choose a different environment, before deleting it.

source.title: Where this configuration comes from
source.captionRepo: Repository entrusted by the configuration module

version.title: Hosted version
version.none: No version is ordered for this environment. Pick one below: it will be pushed to the stack, which then comes and fetches its content.
version.nonePublished: This workspace has no version saved in its repository. Versions are saved from the configuration module.
version.notApplied: order received, version not served yet

refusals.pair_non_apparie: no stack is paired with this environment
refusals.pair_refuse: the stack refused our signed call
refusals.reponse_illisible: the stack answered something other than expected
refusals.origine_absente: this module has no public address configured: it cannot sign anything
refusals.non_applique: order received, version not served yet
refusals.aucun_pair: the stack says it is paired with nobody
refusals.relais_injoignable: the stack could not come and fetch the content
refusals.relais_refuse: the content was refused to it
refusals.commit_inattendu: the content received did not carry the ordered version: the stack rejected it
refusals.bundle_illisible: the content received could not be opened
refusals.bundle_trop_volumineux: the content exceeds what can travel

errors.noWorkspace: No workspace is placed on this environment: there is no version to choose.
errors.notConfided: No paired configuration module exposes this workspace. Its repository was removed along with the pairing: pair the configuration module again.
errors.noRepo: This workspace's repository is not configured yet in the configuration module.
errors.unknownVersion: This version no longer exists in the repository. Refresh the list and pick another one.
errors.repository: The repository could not be read.
errors.unexpected: The request did not go through.

reasons.identifiants: The confided credential was refused by the forge.
reasons.depot_inexistant: The forge does not know this repository.
reasons.protection: The forge refused on a protection rule.
reasons.droit_refuse: The confided credential may not read this repository.
reasons.credential_illisible: The confided credential no longer opens here: have it confided again from the configuration module.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.pending: Accounts are stored on the environment stack, which will expose their search and pagination. This page will show them as soon as those routes exist.
